sql_templates.description: Fetch data for FII/DII flows, market regime, breadth, and index for last 5 sessions.
sql_templates.name: fii_dii_regime_breadth_query
sql_templates.query:
WITH latest_data AS ( 
    SELECT MAX(trade_date) as max_date 
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows 
), 
flow_data AS ( 
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_5d, dii_net_5d, flow_signal 
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows 
    WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data) - INTERVAL '4 days' 
), 
regime_data AS ( 
    SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence 
    FROM signals.regime_history 
    WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data) - INTERVAL '4 days' 
), 
breadth_data AS ( 
    SELECT trade_date, advances, declines, ad_signal 
    FROM breadth.market_daily 
    WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data) - INTERVAL '4 days' 
), 
index_data AS ( 
    SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close, change_pct 
    FROM market.index_eod 
    WHERE trade_date >= (SELECT max_date FROM latest_data) - INTERVAL '4 days' AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50' 
) 
SELECT fd.trade_date, fd.fii_net_5d, fd.dii_net_5d, fd.flow_signal, rd.regime, rd.confidence, bd.advances, bd.declines, bd.ad_signal, id.close, id.change_pct 
FROM flow_data fd 
JOIN regime_data rd ON fd.trade_date = rd.trade_date 
JOIN breadth_data bd ON fd.trade_date = bd.trade_date 
JOIN index_data id ON fd.trade_date = id.trade_date;

synthesis_guidance: ['Analyze flow_signal and ad_signal for risk-on/off insights.', 'Use regime and index confirmation to support flow analysis.', 'Provide portfolio-aware output leveraging breadth and regime context.']
title: FII DII Regime Breadth Review Variant 1422
